description: After nearly 100 years of service, the Massachusetts Department of Transportation has decided that the Sumner Tunnel (Route 1A South) needs a full upgrade. The full upgrade seeks to improve tunnel safety, the roadway surface, tunnel ceiling, lighting and security systems, and cell phone, GPS, and radio service inside the tunnel.
